protocol.hop_distance: directed shortest path from state to shift source
protocol.auc: trapezoidal mean over call 0 through call 25
protocol.aggregation: mean states within hop bin, mean shifts within seed, Student-t 95% CI across seeds

metric_definitions.xi_auc: AUC of mean absolute residual xi per state
metric_definitions.tau_auc: AUC of mean absolute topology signal tau per state
metric_definitions.beta_tau_auc: AUC of mean absolute beta_t times tau per state
